about_the_game:
Resistance of Gaia: The Last Hope

Fight. Grow. Cool the Planet.

In the near future, the climate crisis has reached a boiling point. The global elite have locked themselves inside climate-controlled domes, while the rest of humanity suffers under deadly heat. To make matters worse, they have deployed an army of eco-fascist robots with a mission: eradicate all natural life—and anyone who depends on it.

You are Leya, an elemental spirit of nature, born from the ashes of the last destroyed environmental laboratory. You are the last hope. Use elemental powers to restore vegetation, reduce global temperature, and resist the forces of destruction.

Survive a World in Flames

  • Control the Temperature:
    Your main goal is to reduce the planet’s temperature by planting green rooftops. If the heat rises too far, humanity will not survive.

  • Fight the Mechanical Threat:
    Face robotic enemies and protect what remains of nature.

Master Nature

  • Elemental Abilities:
    Use nature-based powers to attack and defend.

  • Cultivate Life:
    Plant native vegetation to support your mission.

Dynamic and Strategic Gameplay

  • Explore and Build:
    Climb buildings and transform gray rooftops into green spaces.

  • Defend Your Creations:
    Robotic threats will attempt to destroy your plants. Use strategy and positioning to protect them.

A Living World

  • Environmental Narrative:
    Experience a story inspired by themes of hope, resistance, and climate justice.

  • Solarpunk Soundtrack:
    An atmospheric and engaging musical experience.

Key Features

🌿 2.5D Action-Adventure with elements of tower defense and ecosystem management

🌎 A powerful theme centered on climate justice and resistance

🌱 Inspired by real Brazilian plant life

Join the Resistance. Make the World Green Again.
